builds.name: Reference: Mixed tank
builds.goal: Reference for Tahm Kench: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A durable melee controller who builds taste stacks through attacks and Q, then chooses a stun, enemy Devour or allied rescue. Grey health creates a timing choice between recovery and immediate shield. Bonus health multiplies the passive AP contribution; measure three-stack access, Q stack consumption and E shield versus grey healing. A no-health AP route is deliberately lower confidence. Health, armor/MR and close-range effects test reliable frontline contact.
testPlan: Kit question for Tahm Kench: Bonus health multiplies the passive AP contribution; measure three-stack access, Q stack consumption and E shield versus grey healing. A no-health AP route is deliberately lower confidence.

Start with the early core (Matchup defense or Heartsteel only if stacking is safe) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Health, armor/MR and close-range effects test reliable frontline contact. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Tahm Kench lashes out with his tongue, damaging and slowing the first unit hit and healing himself if he strikes an enemy champion.

Applies a stack of  An Acquired Taste to enemy champions. If the champion already has 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, they are stunned and the stacks are consumed. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Heartsteel stacks must be finite; percent-health damage and kiting punish excessive health.

The route fails Tahm Kench's stated kit question: Bonus health multiplies the passive AP contribution; measure three-stack access, Q stack consumption and E shield versus grey healing. A no-health AP route is deliberately lower confidence.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Heartsteel stacks must be finite; percent-health damage and kiting punish excessive health.
Full cost 15,700 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Matchup defense or Heartsteel only if stacking is safe. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Unending Despair, Spirit Visage, Jak'Sho, The Protean are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

kitEvidence.formula:
Deals [75 / 120 / 165 / 210 / 255 + (1) × AP] magic damage to the first enemy hit and Slows them by [50]% for [2] seconds. 

On champion hit, heals Tahm for [10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50] +[(0.05 / 0.055 / 0.06 / 0.065 / 0.07) × 100]% of his missing Health and applies a stack of {{ Spell_TahmKenchPassive_Name }} dealing @Spell.TahmKenchPassive:TotalDamage@ extra magic damage. If that champion already had 3 stacks of {{ Spell_TahmKenchPassive_Name }}, they will also be Stunned for [1.5] seconds, consuming the stacks.

Activate Devour while your tongue is in midair to devour enemy champions who already have 3 stacks of {{ Spell_TahmKenchPassive_Name }} from a distance when you hit them.

Dive down and then re-appear at target location, dealing [100 / 135 / 170 / 205 / 240 + (1.5) × AP] magic damage and Knock Up all enemies in an area for [1] second. Hitting at least one enemy champion refunds [(0.4 / 0.425 / 0.45 / 0.475 / 0.5) × 100]% of the Cooldown and Mana cost. 

Devoured allies can be taken along for the ride (but can always hop out early).

Attacks deal [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=5, perLevel=5, changes=[{"mLevel": 12, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 5.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.04) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2] + (((0.0125) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]) × (0.01)) × AP] bonus magic damage. Against champions, they add a stack of {{ Spell_TahmKenchPassive_Name }} for [5] seconds, up to [3] times.

At [3] stacks, Tongue Lash and Devour become empowered against that champion.

Tahm Kench devours a champion for a few seconds. He can Recast to spit them out.

Enemy Champions: Require 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste. Are devoured for up to [3] seconds and take [100 / 250 / 400] (+[0.15 + (0.0007) × AP] of their Max Health) magic damage. Tahm Kench is Slowed by [40]% and Grounded during this effect.

Ally Champions: Are devoured for up to [3] seconds and are granted [650 / 800 / 950 + (1) × AP] Shield which decays gradually after being spit out. Allies can also choose to exit early. Tahm Kench is Grounded during this effect, but can cast {{Spell_TahmKenchW_Name}} and gains [60]% Move Speed for [3] seconds.

Passive: [(0.15 / 0.23 / 0.31 / 0.39 / 0.47) × 100]% of damage Tahm Kench takes is stored by his Thick Skin, increased to [(0.42 / 0.44 / 0.46 / 0.48 / 0.5) × 100]% if there are at least [2] nearby enemy champions. If Kench has not taken damage within [4] seconds, Thick Skin will rapidly be consumed to heal Tahm for [characterLevelInterpolation(0.6 → 1; raw flags preserved)] of its value.
